basis: First cohort only; descriptive post-hoc analysis, not replacement headline metrics or causal effect estimates. Dataset labels remain secondary evidence.
bootstrap_observation: Identical Sol requests with the same first20 images produce different catalogs before either assignment backend runs; reference splits footwear types while LD creates Footwear.
maintenance_limitation: Creating a cluster retries Other but does not automatically revisit unaffected named assignments. Three bag-labeled inputs already in Trousers therefore remain there after a Bags cluster is created.
